change_reason: initial filing after round-1 refutation pass + round-2 independent run

severity.label: low
severity.rationale: The settlement tps fee is exponential in the window rate and unbounded relative to any author's balance; a flood window (count>=30, elapsed=1) charges each settling author ~10.7% of the total supply, permanently freezing small authors (balance plunges negative; validation.js:1087 min-fee gate rejects all later units). Impact is capped: the attacker must fund the declared fees (inputs cover them), so count is bounded by ~32 even at 100% supply; damage is ~1:1 with attacker expense (below the program's 200% bar) and scatter (not targetable). Infinity is unreachable (funding bound). Low: real mechanism, demonstrated cap.

claims.attacker_model: a network participant able to author units (with funds to declare fees) and to set unit timestamps equal to a recent MC unit's second (timestamps have no past bound; validation.js:280-285 bounds only the future)
preconditions: attacker funds a linear chain of ~30 units (declared fees) landing on the MC in a 1-second window
the MC unit and its last-ball unit share a whole-second timestamp (elapsed = 0 -> ||1)

mechanism.statement: getFinalTpsFee (storage.js:1228-1234) = round(base_tps_fee * (exp(tps/tps_interval) - 1)) with base_tps_fee=10, tps_interval=1 (initial_votes.js:36-37) and elapsed = (mc_ts - last_ball_ts) || 1 (storage.js:1174). At count=30 units in the window with equal-second timestamps, the settlement fee is 106,864,745,815,235 base units (10.7% of the 1e15 supply); updateTpsFees (storage.js:1246-1261) writes tps_fees_balance += declared - fee, driving every author settling in the window to a large negative balance; validation.js:1087 then rejects all their later units (min-fee gate). At count>=709 the double overflows to Infinity (unreachable: the funding bound caps count at ~32).

reachability.statement: Equal timestamps are valid (validation.js:692-693 allows equality with parents; no past bound). A linear chain of 30 units each referencing the previous becomes 30 MC units between two OP waypoints; each must declare+fund a fee >= the local estimate (validation.js:1087, 2649-2653) — the attacker's expense is ~10.7% of supply for the final units, which is the economic cap. Any honest unit settling in the same window is poisoned.
causal_spine: attacker authors 30-unit chain with equal-second timestamps
chain lands on the MC in a 1-second window (elapsed=1)
settlement fee = exp(30)-1 times base = 106,865 GBYTE
every author in the window gets balance -= fee

impact_claims: c-003-impact: honest authors settling in a flood window are frozen (cannot author units; recoverable only by paying >the debt)
c-004-impact: scatter (not targetable); ~1:1 damage vs attacker expense -> below the program's 200%-expense bar; griefing-downgrade likely applies; Infinity variant unreachable
claims.uncertainty: A full multi-unit attack run (30 valid units through real validation+stabilization) was not executed (the fee arithmetic + balance write + gate rejection are each confirmed on the real path). The program's feasibility rules may downgrade this below reportable.
claims.conflicting_evidence: R2 refuted the Infinity variant (funding bound) and the permanence-as-stated (repayable debt for holders > debt); both corrections are incorporated.

fresh_state_properties: synthetic stable-unit cache shaped like a 30-unit flood window (documented in evidence-R2.md)

contamination_disposition.note: Deterministic arithmetic on synthetic-but-real-path state; no network input; no shared state.

claim_proofs.note: fee=106,864,745,815,235 at count=30/elapsed=1 (independent run); honest balance -106,864,745,815,218; gate rejection confirmed; -Infinity persists as REAL -Inf in the sqlite file across pool reopen

control_applicability.note: normal rate (count ~1-5, elapsed>1) yields small deltas; the min-fee gate rejection of the poisoned author is the observed control
no independent positive oracle; the real-path arithmetic is the evidence

adjudication.justification: Round-1 refuter (R2) drove the real storage path and measured the poisoning; round-2 independent reviewer (IR-F4) reproduced all four checkpoints from raw output including -Infinity persistence. The Infinity variant and permanence-as-stated were refuted by R2 (funding bound; repayable debt) and incorporated. Severity Low: real mechanism with a demonstrated economic cap below the program's in-scope bar.
